settings.subtitle: Everyone currently in the clan. Open a member to see their stats, gains, Citadel record and adventure log.
What members have been up to — level-ups, milestones, quests, boss kills, drops and Citadel caps, straight from their adventure logs.
The clan's records and the members who hold them. Records cover what the bot has tracked since it began polling.
How the clan has grown, who's come and gone, and who is closest to their next rank.
Pick two members to see them side by side, skill by skill.
Live from the clan's bot: polled XP, Citadel activity, joins and leaves. Weeks run Wednesday to Tuesday, the way the Citadel resets.

settings.markdown: Numbers come from the bot's regular RuneMetrics polling, so they trail the game by a few hours.

settings.subtitle: Your clan's week, month or year in review. Each member's own recap is on their member page.
Who gained the most XP, who capped the Citadel, and who joined or left — for any month, or any time frame you pick.
Every member by every Citadel week (Wednesday to Tuesday). A square in the clan colour means they capped, a blue one that they visited.
Boss kills and notable drops from members' adventure logs. Pick a boss for its full breakdown, or open the drop log to filter across bosses.
The clan's drops as a collection log. Filter by boss and time frame; items turn up in colour as they're received.
What members have donated and how it's been given back. Totals only — individual balances stay private.
What's coming up in {clan}'s Discord. Times are shown in your own timezone; click an event to open it in Discord.
Upcoming Discord events by day, in your own timezone.
Bingos, hunts and competitions you are in or can join. Open one to see your team, your progress, what you've sent and where the channels are.
Sign up for events and groups right here — it's the same list as the one in Discord.
Vote right here — your vote shows up on the Discord poll too, and the other way round. Verified clan members can vote.
Your linked RuneScape name, goals, events and what the clan can see about you.
